description: The substrate's authored-vs-trained paradigm contrast made explicit. Tracr (RASP → exact transformer weights), constructive ReLU networks (CPWL), ELM (analytic readout), neurosymbolic. Each mechanism that makes 'understanding → weights' possible. This is the substrate's preferred paradigm; ML training is a different approach with different trade-offs.

sub_mechanisms.name: Tracr_RASP_compilation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Lindner 2023. Write program in RASP (Restricted Access Sequence Processing). Compile to exact transformer weights implementing it.
sub_mechanisms.why: The flagship of authored networks. Algorithm: select + aggregate primitives compose like normal programming. Compile → weights. Network implements algorithm exactly + provably. The substrate's gadgets Mt instantiates this.

sub_mechanisms.name: RASP_primitives
sub_mechanisms.definition: Select (predicate of pairs → attention pattern), Aggregate (attention pattern + value → reduce), Map (per-position transformation).
sub_mechanisms.why: Small DSL covering transformer's expressiveness. Each primitive compiles to specific attention + MLP structure. Closed under composition: chain primitives = chain network blocks.

sub_mechanisms.name: CPWL_constructive_relu
sub_mechanisms.definition: Any continuous piecewise-linear function exactly representable as ReLU network. Arora 2018 constructive proof.
sub_mechanisms.why: Given CPWL function f, can derive weights of ReLU net implementing f exactly. Substrate's gadgets Mt has ~80 such constructions: identity, abs, max, min, polynomial evaluator, multiplexer.

sub_mechanisms.name: ELM_extreme_learning_machine
sub_mechanisms.definition: Random hidden weights; analytic least-squares for output weights. β = pinv(H) · T.
sub_mechanisms.why: Training-free for the readout. Closed form. The substrate uses this in code_writing_cortex's analytic_construction. Different from gradient descent: no iteration, exact for given hidden features.

sub_mechanisms.name: neurosymbolic_AlphaGeometry
sub_mechanisms.definition: Neural model proposes geometric constructions; symbolic solver verifies. Solved IMO-level geometry 2024.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hybrid: neural for creative proposal; symbolic for rigour. Each handles what the other can't. DeepMind's flagship demonstration. The substrate's design philosophy: symbolic primary, neural where it adds value.

sub_mechanisms.name: symbolic_knowledge_representation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Facts as graph: entities, relationships, types, attributes. SPARQL, Cyc microtheories, RDF + OWL.
sub_mechanisms.why: Explicit + queryable + provable. No statistical fit; knowledge is what's encoded. The substrate's Mts ARE this. Reading the graph = querying knowledge directly.

sub_mechanisms.name: deductive_inference
sub_mechanisms.definition: From premises + rules derive conclusions. Modus ponens, syllogisms, resolution. Sound: conclusions follow from premises.
sub_mechanisms.why: Different from statistical generalisation. The substrate's rule graph supports this. Conclusions are derivable, not generated. Truth-preserving when rules + premises are.

sub_mechanisms.name: provable_correctness
sub_mechanisms.definition: Network's behavior can be proven to match specification. Possible for authored networks; difficult for trained.
sub_mechanisms.why: Tracr proves exact behaviour per spec. Trained networks have only statistical guarantees + empirical evaluation. Different epistemic stance: 'this network IS X' vs 'this network performs X with 99% accuracy on test set'.

sub_mechanisms.name: interpretable_by_construction
sub_mechanisms.definition: Network's structure reveals its computation. Each weight = specific algorithmic role.
sub_mechanisms.why: Tracr networks are readable: this attention head implements that RASP operation. Trained networks: post-hoc mechanistic interpretability tries to recover this. The substrate prefers the construction approach.

sub_mechanisms.name: no_training_data_required
sub_mechanisms.definition: Authored networks don't need training data. Designed from specification.
sub_mechanisms.why: Training-bound paradigm fails without data. Authored paradigm doesn't have this dependency. The substrate's gadgets work from declarative input, not corpus.

sub_mechanisms.name: compositional_correctness
sub_mechanisms.definition: Compose authored networks; correctness composes. f∘g correct if f and g are.
sub_mechanisms.why: Algebraic structure. Trained network composition: surprises common, debugging hard. Authored composition: known behaviour. The substrate's gadgets compose via cpwl_composed gadget kind.

sub_mechanisms.name: the_substrate_uses_authored_primarily
sub_mechanisms.definition: Substrate's Mts ARE symbolic knowledge. Gadgets ARE authored networks. Tracr-compiled where networks needed. Training-free + provable.
sub_mechanisms.why: Design choice. Not 'no ML' but 'authored primary'. Where ML adds value (statistical pattern recognition not expressible algorithmically), neurosymbolic interfaces. The substrate doesn't run gradient descent on itself.

derivation_rules.name: Tracr_RASP_provides_exact_weights
if: a RASP program is compiled via Tracr
then: resulting transformer weights implement the program exactly
derivation_rules.why: Compilation is constructive: each RASP primitive maps to specific attention + MLP structure. Weights produced + network behaviour proven. No SGD; no random init; no training data. The 'understanding → weights' direct path.

derivation_rules.name: authored_network_interpretability_by_construction
if: network is compiled from declarative spec
then: its computation is directly readable from structure
derivation_rules.why: Each component has known algorithmic role. The substrate's gadgets carry their construction history as attrs. Mechanistic interpretability of authored networks is trivial; of trained networks is research.

derivation_rules.name: authored_paradigm_avoids_failure_modes
if: network is exactly compiled from specification
then: hallucination + adversarial + distribution shift are not applicable
derivation_rules.why: Specification defines behaviour. Outside specification, behaviour is whatever spec says (typically default value). Doesn't 'hallucinate' because it doesn't generate; doesn't fail OOD because no distribution assumption. Different paradigm; different failure profile.

derivation_rules.name: no_training_data_required_for_authoring
derivation_rules.why: Training paradigm: data-hungry, expensive to collect. Authored paradigm: needs specification (algorithm or function definition). Different cost structure. The substrate operates in the authored regime; data not its currency.

derivation_rules.name: neurosymbolic_acknowledges_both_paradigms
if: a system combines symbolic structure + neural learning
then: it can do what neither alone can
derivation_rules.why: Pure neural: statistical pattern recognition without provable structure. Pure symbolic: brittle to noise + unhandled cases. Combined: symbolic primary + neural where useful. AlphaGeometry, AlphaProof demonstrate. The substrate's design.
